  <section v="18">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Based on the earlier explanation that the form of creatures is a vessel for their divine life-force, this life-force is identified as the will, and the fact that the divine life-force clothes itself in each creature according to its nature indicates that creatures occupy a place relative to it only because it so arose in His will.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">9)</t>

    <t s="5">is a vessel for the divine life-force within them</t>
    <t s="6">(their soul),</t>
    <t s="7">it may be said,</t>
    <t s="8">that the life-force and soul of the creatures are the will.</t>
    <t s="9">And from this it is understood,</t>
    <t s="10">that this [fact] that the divine life-force clothes itself in every creature and animates it according to its particular nature,</t>
    <t s="11">which indicates that the creatures occupy a place relative to it</t>
    <t s="12">(as above, section 3),</t>
    <t s="13">is</t>
    <t s="14">[not because the creatures in themselves occupy a place relative to it,</t>

    <t s="16">(as above, section 8),</t>

    <t s="19">and therefore He clothes Himself in the creatures and animates each creature according to its particular nature.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="19">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Based on this, the difference between natural conduct and miraculous conduct is that in natural conduct the will is to conduct the world in a way that the world is a reality (lower is yesh), while in miraculous conduct the will is to conduct the world in a way that the world is considered as nothing (lower is ayin).</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And based on this,</t>
    <t s="1">the distinction between natural conduct and miraculous conduct,</t>
    <t s="2">[namely] that natural conduct is through lower intellect and miraculous conduct is through higher intellect</t>
    <t s="3">(as brought above from the discourses),</t>
    <t s="4">is,</t>
    <t s="5">that the will in natural conduct is to conduct the world in a way that the world is a reality,</t>
    <t s="6">the lower [realm] is yesh,</t>
    <t s="7">and the will in miraculous conduct is to conduct the world in a way that the world is considered as nothing,</t>
    <t s="8">the lower [realm] is ayin.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="20">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>There are two modes within the general concept of lower intellect: one where the lower realm is inherently a reality and the two intellects are opposite in essence, and another where the perception of lower as yesh is for the sake of revealing the aspect of higher than high without end, making the two intellects essentially one matter.</sectionSummaryBrief>

    <t s="8">And among the distinctions between the two modes is,</t>

    <t s="11">For lower intellect is that the lower [realm] is yesh, and higher intellect is that the lower [realm] is ayin.</t>
    <t s="12">And in the second mode, where the intellect that the lower [realm] is yesh is in order that there should be a revelation of the aspect of higher than high without end,</t>
    <t s="13">the opposition of the two intellects is only in their conceptualization,</t>

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Based on the earlier explanation that the form of creatures is a vessel for their divine life-force, this life-force is identified as the will, and the fact that the divine life-force clothes itself in each creature according to its nature indicates that creatures occupy a place relative to it only because it so arose in His will.

translations.translation: And according to what was explained above
(section 7)
that the form of the creatures
(the form of the matter)
is a vessel for the divine life-force within them
(their soul),
it may be said,
that the life-force and soul of the creatures are the will.
And from this it is understood,
that this [fact] that the divine life-force clothes itself in every creature and animates it according to its particular nature,
which indicates that the creatures occupy a place relative to it
(as above, section 3),
is
[not because the creatures in themselves occupy a place relative to it,
for the matter of coming into being from the will is that through them the will is completed
(as above, section 8),
but rather]
because it so arose in His will, blessed be He, that there should be a place-occupancy for the creatures,
and therefore He clothes Himself in the creatures and animates each creature according to its particular nature.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Based on this, the difference between natural conduct and miraculous conduct is that in natural conduct the will is to conduct the world in a way that the world is a reality (lower is yesh), while in miraculous conduct the will is to conduct the world in a way that the world is considered as nothing (lower is ayin).

translations.translation: And based on this,
the distinction between natural conduct and miraculous conduct,
[namely] that natural conduct is through lower intellect and miraculous conduct is through higher intellect
(as brought above from the discourses),
is,
that the will in natural conduct is to conduct the world in a way that the world is a reality,
the lower [realm] is yesh,
and the will in miraculous conduct is to conduct the world in a way that the world is considered as nothing,
the lower [realm] is ayin.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: There are two modes within the general concept of lower intellect: one where the lower realm is inherently a reality and the two intellects are opposite in essence, and another where the perception of lower as yesh is for the sake of revealing the aspect of higher than high without end, making the two intellects essentially one matter.

translations.translation: And this is the matter.
And it may be said,
that this is the case regarding the general concept of lower intellect,
that it has two modes.
[One mode is] that the intellect that the lower [realm] is yesh is because relative to this level the lower [realm] in itself is a reality
(and its self-nullification is only the nullification of the yesh).
And [the other mode is] that the intellect that the lower [realm] is yesh is in order that there should be a revelation of the aspect of higher than high without end.
And among the distinctions between the two modes is,
that in the first mode, where the lower [realm] in itself is a reality,
lower intellect and higher intellect are two intellects that are opposite in their essential substance.
For lower intellect is that the lower [realm] is yesh, and higher intellect is that the lower [realm] is ayin.
And in the second mode, where the intellect that the lower [realm] is yesh is in order that there should be a revelation of the aspect of higher than high without end,
the opposition of the two intellects is only in their conceptualization,
but in their essential substance they are one matter.
For the content of both intellects is the revelation of the matters that are in Ein Sof,
except that higher intellect is the revelation of the lower [realm] without limit,
and lower intellect is the revelation of the higher [realm] without end.
